prior_art_boundary: Reviewed current GEMSDOE48 README/docs, archived H48/H49 research and selected 16GEMSDOE H18 records plus bounded GitHub code-search results. H18-5/H49-1 already proposed broad geothermal/2m-probe ideas, but no implementation or holdout result for the exact H50-1 repeat-survey residual-persistence operator was found. No global novelty claim is made.
ranking_basis: Qualitative expected public-proxy value versus implementation/data cost; no numeric DTI gains assigned before a frozen holdout. H50-1 ranks first for direct observability, verified in-mask data, and low-cost falsifiability.

hypotheses.title: Repeat-survey 2 m thermal residual persistence
layers: GDR 1391 2 m probe shapefile: T2m, Date, T2m_2..T2m_7 and Date_2..Date_7
hypotheses.physical_signature: Same-area, same-exact-date, leave-one-station-out positive temperature residuals repeated across distinct survey dates; 300 m point support.
hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Persistent shallow heat advection may mark fluid-bearing structures without a mappable surface trace.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior: H18-5/H49-1 proposed broad thermal targeting, including elevation detrending and lineament collinearity. No repeat-visit, leave-one-station-out, same-survey-date persistence implementation was found; this is a specific unexecuted test, not a new-data/global-novelty claim.
hypotheses.expected_dti: Unknown; qualitative moderate potential, with major sparse/clustered-sampling risk.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low; archive parser, exact grid rasterization, and fixed four-block evaluation.
hypotheses.data_status: Pinned 1.08 MB owner-mirror bytes hash-verified; official GDR landing page reports CC BY 4.0. 2,782 of 3,800 points intersect finite competition cells; 139 in-footprint stations have multiple dated readings; 26 meet the frozen persistence rule. Not organizer-authenticated.

preregistered_rule.dated_observation: finite nonzero T2m with a nonblank Date; zero-valued dated readings cause a flagged failure; blank-date nonzero fields are counted and excluded
preregistered_rule.baseline_group: Area x exact date, only if >=5 distinct station records; aggregate duplicate same-station same-date readings by median
preregistered_rule.residual: station/date median minus the median of other stations in the same Area/date group
preregistered_rule.persistent_station: at least two eligible distinct dates, median residual >= 2 Celsius, and at least half of eligible date residuals >= 2 Celsius
preregistered_rule.fallback: if fewer than two eligible distinct dates, include only when source 2mDAB > 0; a repeat station that has two eligible dates but fails persistence is excluded
preregistered_rule.raster: binary 1 within 300 m of selected station coordinates, 0 elsewhere inside the finite mask, NaN/nodata outside; no label or known-fault-distance feature

hypotheses.promotion_gate: On newer derived SGMC off-catalogue proxy, mean DTI must exceed H49 same-protocol mean by >=0.005 absolute, with positive paired difference in >=3/4 quadrants; direction must also be positive on older raw-SGMC sensitivity. This is a conservative research gate, not a statistical CI or organizer threshold. Slot still closed without fold-independent rebuild and private/organizer evidence.

hypotheses.title: Multi-date Landsat Collection 2 surface-temperature persistence
hypotheses.physical_signature: Repeated local positive surface-temperature residuals across clear-sky seasons, skeletonized into elongated coherent anomalies.
hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Persistent surface heating may indicate fluid pathways below alluvium despite a weak or absent scarp.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior: Satellite surface-temperature time series, rather than sparse GDR 2 m probes or conductive heat-flow residuals; no Landsat ST feature workflow was found in reviewed campaign files.
hypotheses.expected_dti: Unknown; qualitative moderate potential, high environmental-confounding risk.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: High; multi-scene QA, seasonal normalization, emissivity and missing-data controls.
hypotheses.data_status: USGS STAC bbox query returned 34,447 Level-2 ST scene records and an intersecting recent item; exact mask coverage and useful-pixel count unaudited; no payload downloaded.

hypotheses.title: Fault-plane corridors from USGS ComCat focal mechanisms
layers: focal-mechanism nodal planes, dip and rake
hypotheses.physical_signature: Spatially coherent nodal-plane orientations and event clusters mapped as fault-plane corridors, not raw event density.
hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Rupture-plane orientation can expose active blind fault geometry absent from a geomorphic trace inventory.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior: Campaign seismicity-density features summarize event counts; this proposal uses mechanism solutions and plane kinematics. No focal-mechanism operator was found in the reviewed files.
hypotheses.expected_dti: Unknown; qualitative low-to-moderate potential; active seismicity may not represent geothermal faults.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium; API retrieval, duplicate-origin resolution, depth/completeness filtering and spatial blocks.
hypotheses.data_status: Official FDSN count endpoint returned 8,185 focal-mechanism and 746 moment-tensor product-associated events in the approximate bbox for M>=2.5 since 1970; bbox extends outside the footprint; no event payload downloaded.

hypotheses.title: Sentinel-2 SWIR alteration boundaries
layers: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A B11/B12 SWIR and B4/B8 optical reflectance
hypotheses.physical_signature: Published clay/iron-oxide spectral ratios composited in dry-season cloud-free scenes, followed by spatially coherent alteration-boundary extraction.
hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Hydrothermal mineral alteration may extend beyond visible fault scarps, particularly across exposed basin margins.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior: Optical satellite reflectance/mineralogical signal rather than GeoDAWN airborne radiometric K/Th/total-count features; no Sentinel-2 implementation was found in reviewed campaign files.
hypotheses.expected_dti: Unknown; qualitative low-to-moderate potential, limited by cover and lithologic ambiguity.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: High; multi-date cloud/shadow handling and mineral-ratio calibration.
hypotheses.data_status: Official Copernicus STAC returned one 2026 L2A item intersecting the approximate bbox and advertises 20 m B11/B12 assets. This is not full-footprint coverage; asset authorization references OIDC; no payload downloaded.

holdout_protocol.geometry: Four fixed 2x2 quadrants on the 3292 x 3730 EPSG:32611 100 m grid; held-out core plus 300 m evaluation halo.
holdout_protocol.primary_truth: Owner-mirror on-grid USGS SGMC traces >300 m from owner-mirror catalogue cells; not organizer-authenticated and not private expert truth.
holdout_protocol.secondary_sensitivity: Older raw owner-mirror SGMC raster, scored separately; never pooled with primary.
holdout_protocol.metric: Official distance-weighted Tversky equations, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, triangular radius=300 m.
holdout_protocol.slot_decision: No slot is cleared by a public-proxy result; H50-1 must pass the frozen numerical gate and independent-source requirements first.
